description: Finds LogTriage's reference pages for an investigation: Windows Security event IDs, Entra AADSTS, NTSTATUS and Kerberos codes, AWS CloudTrail events (ConsoleLogin, AssumeRole...), CrowdStrike Falcon events (ProcessRollup2...), sshd/PAM log messages, web scanner probes, scanner user agents, log format field references and the free tools. Each page explains what the entry means, the fields to read and queries (KQL, CQL, SPL, bash) to investigate it. Returns the best matches with links. Free; no API key needed.

query.description: An event ID, event name, code, log message or words.

name: search_reference
title: Search LogTriage's security log reference
